headline: Dangote Cement Rally Drives Nigerian Equities to Record High
summary: Nigeria's equity market surged to an all-time record capitalization of 164.97 trillion naira on Thursday, lifted primarily by a major rally in shares of Dangote Cement.
why: Dangote Cement is Nigeria's largest listed company by market capitalization, wielding considerable influence over broad market indexes and foreign portfolio flows into West Africa.

impacts.name: NGX All-Share Index
impacts.why: Gains in market heavyweight Dangote Cement directly pushed aggregate domestic market capitalization to a new high.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A heavy concentration of buying interest in index-heavyweight Dangote Cement pulled total Nigerian equity valuation to a record N164.97 trillion.
